item.title: Founding of Northstar
item.description:
Summary

Northstar was founded as the northern seat that later became the heart of Northwaldia.

item.title: Founding of Northwaldia
item.description:
Summary

Northwaldia was founded when the northern crown joined its surrounding holdings under a single kingdom.

item.title: Founding of the Northwald Lineage
item.description:
Summary

The Northwald lineage traces its formal origin to the consolidation of the northern royal houses.
